lead.headline: Jefferson's last practice is today; Warren banks 15.6
lead.deck: Two DNPs and still 18.7 on ESPN. Addison is the cover. Warren finished 1.4 under his number, and Wright's full practice turns Gordon into a split.
lead.body: Justin Jefferson has not practised this week, and nothing overnight changed that. The Vikings' Friday session is his last before a designation, and ESPN still projects 18.7. The plan holds: if he is inactive at 12:35 Sunday, Jordan Addison takes his slot; Jalen Coker, limited Thursday, plays too late to be safe cover. Jaylen Warren opened the week with 15.6 at Cleveland, 17 carries for 93 and three catches, 1.4 short of his projection in a 27-24 loss, with Rico Dowdle inactive again. Dowdle may be back next week, and Guillo-tinas dropped him last night. In Chicago, D'Andre Swift's knee is still unpriced: Kyle Monangai sits at 8.4, and is compared with Bhayshul Tuten only if Swift is ruled out. One correction: Jaylen Wright was upgraded to a full practice Thursday, not limited as yesterday's edition said, so Ollie Gordon's work in Miami is a split. And DK Metcalf, rostered in 88% of leagues, is unowned here; he is locked on waivers until Wednesday, which makes him Tuesday's question.
